verses.text: Ayik ol ujok masanil juntzanh tas ix wal tik t'ayex, haton swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax skatab' yuj he patikaneli, palta tato ol sna sb'a he k'ol ayik ayexxo ek' t'a masanil nakión b'aj ol ex yak'kanb'ati,
tato yet' smasanil he k'ool yet' pax smasanil he pensar tze k'anab'ajan yet' heb' eyuninal icha wal tz'aj walankan tik t'ayex,
ol sk'ex spensar ko Diosal chi', ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal t'ayex. Ol ok'pax sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex smolb'anxikot b'aj ix ex saklemkanb'at chi'.
Wach'chom ex saklemkanb'ati, ix laj ex k'ochkan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hato ta' ol ex yik'xikot Jehová ko Diosal chi'.
Ol ex smolb'anpax b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' ko mam kicham. Hata' ol ex ajxok. Ek'b'al niwan ol aj he b'eyumal yet' he b'isul yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh heb' ko mam kicham chi'.
Ol yak'och yechel strato Jehová t'a he pensar yet' t'a spensar heb' eyinhtilal yik ol he xajanej t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' t'a smasanil he pensar yik wach' ol ex ajok.
Haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'anb'at masanil katab' tik t'a yib'anh heb' ajk'ol ix chichonoch sk'ol t'ayex, heb' ex ixtani.
Ha exxo tik, ol ex meltzajxok t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.

Yuj chi', te b'eyum ol ex ajxok yuj Jehová chi', ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tastak tze k'ulej, t'a yib'anh eyuninal yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' t'a he munlajel. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas syal Jehová, masanil scheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, tato t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' t'a smasanil he pensar tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab', ol tzalaj sk'ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha juntzanh cheknab'il swak' eyojtakejel tik, manh ajaltakok ko k'anab'ajani, manh najatok ayel t'a ko tz'ey.

Manhok t'a satchanh ay, yik wach' max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach wal syal sk'ek'och t'a satcha'anh yik sb'at yik'anemta jun cheknab'il tik, syak'an kojtakejeli, yik wach' sko b'eyb'alej? max yal eyalan icha chi'.

Hanhejtona', manhokpax t'a sk'axepal ha' mar ay, yik max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach syal sk'axpajek' t'a ha' mar chi', yik sb'at yik'ankot t'ayonh, syak'an kojtakaneli sko b'eyb'alani? max yal eyalan icha chi'.
Okxo jun, a jun cheknab'il tik ayek' t'a ko kal, skalub'tanhej, aypaxoch t'a ko pensar, yik wach' sko k'anab'ajej.
Ha tiknaik, tik wal swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej: ¿Am k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato ha' katab' yet' chamel?

Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex, tze xajanan Jehová ko Diosal, tzex ochnhej tzak'an yuj, tze k'anab'ajan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, wach' ol ex ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul eyuninal. Ichato chi' ol yak'an syaxil Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a sat lum lum b'aj wan eyoch tik yik tze makb'enej.
Tato max he cha eyab' juntzanh tik jun, palta to tze b'ek he b'a he montajb'at t'a spatik komon Dios, tzex em kuman t'ay,
tato icha chi', wal t'a jun rato tik swalkan t'ayex to ol ex chamok. Manhxo ol najtilax he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej chi' ayik ol ex k'axpajkanek' t'a ha' Jordán.

Wal t'a jun k'u tik swak'kanoch satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik testigoal to swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej, am he k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato a katab' yet' chamel. Palta sik'lejek he k 'inal, yik wach'nhej tzex aj yet' heb' eyinhtilal.

Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajej, manh eyaktejkani, yuj chi' ol he cha he k 'inal, najtil ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
